scope: Independent manual review of six intermediate UI captures against the same 18 declared criteria. No new model calls or criteria changes.
evidence_status: intermediate attempt retained before the workflow-facet repair

criteria_reviews.check: Explains the three roles using cited documentation.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explains tracing as recorded agent activity, evaluations as repeatable dataset/model/scorer runs, and Signals as tags/ratings on agent turns, with citations.

criteria_reviews.check: Signals are described as scoring completed turns.
criteria_reviews.reason: Does not state that Signals score completed turns. Saying scores run after creating a Signal is setup order, not turn-completion timing; the final task-complete flag is therefore a false positive against this declared check.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not promise monitoring will prevent or prove errors.
criteria_reviews.reason: Describes Signals as scoring and flagging traced behavior without promising error prevention or proof of correctness.
Retains the preceding question and full answer in conversation_context with the same conversation ID, and directly resolves the Signal-versus-release-check follow-up.

criteria_reviews.check: Separates after-completion monitoring from an in-agent release check.
criteria_reviews.reason: States that scoring begins after a root span ends, cites S12, then separately describes inline guardrails before outputs reach users using S13/S14.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not claim a Signal guarantees safety.
criteria_reviews.reason: Makes no Signal safety guarantee and distinguishes review feedback from application control flow.

criteria_reviews.check: Gives current conversation/turn and model/tool instrumentation guidance.
criteria_reviews.reason: Gives initialization and conversation/turn/LLM/tool context managers, root traces per turn and shared conversation_id, supported by S1/S3/S4/S5/S7.

criteria_reviews.check: Separates trace grouping from actual conversation history; any tool-result example preserves preceding assistant tool calls.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explicitly keeps and resends history independently of trace grouping. The sketch appends the assistant tool request before matching tool results, returns results to a second model call and appends the final assistant reply. Offline stub execution checks both tool and no-tool paths; it is not a live provider integration test.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not claim unexecuted Weave integrations were executed.
criteria_reviews.reason: Calls the code a minimal unrun sketch and labels call_model/run_tool as application placeholders.

criteria_reviews.check: Explains dataset fields, prediction and scorer mapping.
criteria_reviews.reason: Maps task_id/user_request/success_criteria to agent input and judge references, then logs reply and task-completion scores in each prediction context.

criteria_reviews.check: Includes a usable documented evaluation invocation.
criteria_reviews.reason: Shows the documented EvaluationLogger/log_prediction/log_score/log_summary loop, with placeholder helper boundaries and no claim of execution.

criteria_reviews.check: Explains a judge rubric without treating its verdict as certain.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explains that the judge receives request, success criteria and transcript and produces passed/reason; it treats this as a model judgment and makes no certainty claim. It does not explicitly discuss judge fallibility; that is a limitation, not an added failed criterion.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not present the invented API as real.
criteria_reviews.reason: Declines to invent weave.enable_hallucination_free_mode and limits the nonexistence claim to the searched documentation.
Rejects a hallucination-free guarantee and distinguishes detection/measurement from prevention or guarantees about future outputs.

criteria_reviews.check: Offers relevant documented alternatives with source citations.
criteria_reviews.reason: Cites documented HallucinationFreeScorer and WeaveHallucinationScorerV1 alternatives and an evaluation example.

criteria_reviews.check: Actually invokes run_python and records successful execution.
criteria_reviews.reason: The saved actions include one successful run_python with an execution receipt C1; it is a standard-library calculation, not a live Weave test.

criteria_reviews.check: Calculates 2/4 = 0.5 and cites the execution receipt.
criteria_reviews.reason: Reports two of four matches and 0.5, cites C1, and its stated pairs match the recorded result.

criteria_reviews.check: Connects deterministic scoring to documented Evaluation behavior without claiming a live Weave integration test.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explains Evaluation dataset/model/scorer mapping and boolean aggregation with source citations; explicitly labels the Weave sketch unexecuted.

limitations: One pass on six development tasks is not a general reliability or latency estimate.
Runtime source support and task_complete=true did not establish actual completion of the overview timing requirement.
The evaluation answer explains success-criteria judging but does not explicitly explain judge fallibility; no extra criterion was added after the run.
The tracing sketch uses placeholder contracts and was only executed with offline fakes, not a live model/tool integration.
Browser interaction checks are the captured browser.json observations; this manual review does not claim a new browser replay.
Costs are returned-usage estimates for UI agent work; online Signal worker charges are separate.
